title: Structure your Seedance 2.0 prompt with a timestamped shot list (e.g…
content:
Structure your Seedance 2.0 prompt with a timestamped shot list (e.g., [0:00-0:01], [0:01-0:02], etc.) to control pacing and ensure specific actions happen at exact moments  
Use a HOOK + MONTAGE + ENDING format (e.g., hook 0:00–0:01, montage 0:02–0:13, ending 0:13–0:15) to create a clear narrative arc within a 15-second clip  
For high-energy sequences, explicitly instruct ultra-fast cuts at a fixed interval (e.g., every 0.5 seconds) and list the rotating shot types to force constant angle changes  
Define character and vehicle as separate labeled blocks (CHARACTER:, CAR:) with detailed descriptors to keep identity and design consistent across shots  
Specify the visual style stack with concrete keywords (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, dark moody tunnel lighting, neon wet-asphalt reflections) to lock the intended look  
If you want sound design, include explicit audio layering instructions (heavy bass music synced to cuts + engine roar + tire screech) directly in the prompt

es.content:
Estructura tu prompt de Seedance 2.0 con una lista de planos con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, [0:00-0:01], [0:01-0:02], etc.) para controlar el ritmo y asegurar que acciones específicas ocurran en momentos exactos  
Usa un formato HOOK + MONTAGE + ENDING (por ejemplo, hook 0:00–0:01, montage 0:02–0:13, ending 0:13–0:15) para crear un arco narrativo claro dentro de un clip de 15 segundos  
Para secuencias de alta energía, indica explícitamente cortes ultrarrápidos a un intervalo fijo (por ejemplo, cada 0.5 segundos) y enumera los tipos de plano que van rotando para forzar cambios constantes de ángulo  
Define al personaje y al vehículo como bloques etiquetados por separado (CHARACTER:, CAR:) con descriptores detallados para mantener la identidad y el diseño consistentes entre planos  
Especifica la capa de estilo visual con palabras clave concretas (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, dark moody tunnel lighting, neon wet-asphalt reflections) para fijar el aspecto deseado  
Si quieres diseño de sonido, incluye instrucciones explícitas de capas de audio (heavy bass music synced to cuts + engine roar + tire screech) directamente en el prompt

fr.content:
Structurez votre prompt Seedance 2.0 avec une liste de plans horodatée (par ex. [0:00-0:01], [0:01-0:02], etc.) pour contrôler le rythme et garantir que des actions précises se produisent à des moments exacts  
Utilisez un format HOOK + MONTAGE + ENDING (par ex. hook 0:00–0:01, montage 0:02–0:13, ending 0:13–0:15) pour créer une arc narratif clair dans un clip de 15 secondes  
Pour les séquences à haute énergie, demandez explicitement des cuts ultra-rapides à intervalle fixe (par ex. toutes les 0,5 secondes) et listez les types de plans alternés pour imposer des changements d’angle constants  
Définissez le personnage et le véhicule comme des blocs séparés et étiquetés (CHARACTER:, CAR:) avec des descripteurs détaillés afin de conserver une identité et un design cohérents d’un plan à l’autre  
Précisez la pile de style visuel avec des mots-clés concrets (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, dark moody tunnel lighting, neon wet-asphalt reflections) pour verrouiller l’esthétique souhaitée  
Si vous souhaitez une conception sonore, incluez directement dans le prompt des instructions explicites de superposition audio (heavy bass music synced to cuts + engine roar + tire screech)

ja.content:
Seedance 2.0 の prompt は、タイムスタンプ付きの shot list（例: [0:00-0:01]、[0:01-0:02] など）で構成し、テンポをコントロールして、特定のアクションが正確なタイミングで起こるようにします  
HOOK + MONTAGE + ENDING の形式（例: hook 0:00–0:01、montage 0:02–0:13、ending 0:13–0:15）を使って、15秒のクリップ内に明確な narrative arc を作ります  
高エネルギーなシーケンスでは、固定間隔（例: 0.5秒ごと）で ultra-fast cuts を明示的に指示し、回転させる shot type を列挙して、常にアングルが変わるようにします  
キャラクターと vehicle は、別々のラベル付きブロック（CHARACTER:、CAR:）として定義し、詳細な descriptors を入れて、ショット間で identity と design の一貫性を保ちます  
visual style stack は、具体的な keywords（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime、semi-realistic CGI、hand-painted textures、Unreal Engine quality、film grain、dark moody tunnel lighting、neon wet-asphalt reflections）で指定し、意図した見た目を固定します  
sound design が必要な場合は、明示的な audio layering の指示（cuts に同期した heavy bass music + engine roar + tire screech）を prompt 内に直接含めます

ko.content:
Seedance 2.0 prompt는 타임스탬프가 포함된 shot list([0:00-0:01], [0:01-0:02] 등)로 구성해 pacing을 제어하고, 특정 동작이 정확한 순간에 발생하도록 하세요.  
HOOK + MONTAGE + ENDING 형식을 사용해(예: hook 0:00–0:01, montage 0:02–0:13, ending 0:13–0:15) 15초 클립 안에 명확한 narrative arc를 만드세요.  
고에너지 시퀀스의 경우, 고정된 간격(예: 0.5초마다)으로 ultra-fast cuts를 명시적으로 지시하고, 회전하는 shot type을 나열해 지속적인 angle 변화를 강제하세요.  
CHARACTER:, CAR:처럼 캐릭터와 차량을 별도의 라벨 블록으로 정의하고, 각 shot에서 identity와 design이 일관되게 유지되도록 상세한 descriptor를 포함하세요.  
시각 스타일 스택은 구체적인 키워드(cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, dark moody tunnel lighting, neon wet-asphalt reflections)로 지정해 의도한 look을 고정하세요.  
sound design을 원한다면, 명시적인 audio layering 지시(컷에 맞춘 heavy bass music + engine roar + tire screech)를 prompt에 직접 포함하세요.

pt.content:
Estruture seu prompt do Seedance 2.0 com uma lista de planos com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, [0:00-0:01], [0:01-0:02], etc.) para controlar o ritmo e garantir que ações específicas aconteçam em momentos exatos  
Use um formato HOOK + MONTAGE + ENDING (por exemplo, hook 0:00–0:01, montage 0:02–0:13, ending 0:13–0:15) para criar um arco narrativo claro dentro de um clipe de 15 segundos  
Para sequências de alta energia, instrua explicitamente cortes ultrarrápidos em um intervalo fixo (por exemplo, a cada 0,5 segundos) e liste os tipos de plano em rotação para forçar mudanças constantes de ângulo  
Defina personagem e veículo como blocos separados e rotulados (CHARACTER:, CAR:) com descritores detalhados para manter a identidade e o design consistentes entre os planos  
Especifique a pilha de estilo visual com palavras-chave concretas (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, dark moody tunnel lighting, neon wet-asphalt reflections) para travar o visual pretendido  
Se quiser sound design, inclua instruções explícitas de camadas de áudio (heavy bass music synced to cuts + engine roar + tire screech) diretamente no prompt

zh.content:
使用带时间戳的镜头列表来构建你的 Seedance 2.0 prompt（例如：[0:00-0:01]、[0:01-0:02] 等），以控制节奏并确保特定动作在准确的时刻发生  
使用 HOOK + MONTAGE + ENDING 的格式（例如，hook 0:00–0:01，montage 0:02–0:13，ending 0:13–0:15），在 15 秒的片段中创建清晰的叙事弧线  
对于高能量序列，明确要求以固定间隔进行超快切镜头（例如每 0.5 秒一次），并列出轮换的镜头类型，以强制持续变化角度  
将角色和车辆定义为两个独立的标注块（CHARACTER:、CAR:），并提供详细描述，以保持跨镜头的身份和设计一致性  
使用具体关键词指定视觉风格堆栈（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime、semi-realistic CGI、hand-painted textures、Unreal Engine quality、film grain、dark moody tunnel lighting、neon wet-asphalt reflections），以锁定预期的视觉效果  
如果你想要声音设计，请在 prompt 中直接加入明确的音频分层指令（heavy bass music synced to cuts + engine roar + tire screech）
